Over 100 high-rise projects successfully completed. MULTIFAMILY Mid-rise Apartments Condominiums Hospitality Senior Living Mixed Use Amenity Centers SPECIALTY FEATURES Architectural Fountains Splash Pads / Spray Parks Hardscape Amenity Areas Fire pits & Grill Structures Drainage & Decking OUR WORK FEATURED PROJECTS A Few of our Completed Projects ABOUT US LEGACY SINCE 1976 Fun N Sun Pools Inc. started in the Dallas / Fort Worth area over 40 years ago. Just out of college, founder Brent Skillman started building pools for childcare centers and small residential developments in 1976. Word spread of their exceptional craftsmanship, unique designs and unwavering customer service. ​ As the company transitioned from small residential to larger multifamily projects, they continued the same passion, eye for detail and commitment to customer satisfaction. That philosophy and dedication has taken Fun N Sun to the top of the commercial pool industry. ​ Today, Fun N Sun is one of the most respected commercial swimming pool companies in the nation for their expertise in the design and construction of commercial pools. With offices in Dallas/Fort Worth and Austin, Fun N Sun maintains an impressive list of clients throughout Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas and Colorado. Our experience insures that pools are designed to look fabulous and last for years, with considerations for cost effective construction, maintenance and operation. ​ CONTACT CONTACT US 3601 Kim Drive, #101 Irving, Texas 75061 ​ 972.790.7311 ​ info@FunNSunPools.com Submit Thanks for submitting! © 2019 - Fun N Sun Pools, Inc | DFW | Austin | Houston | San Antonio bottom of page
